items.title: sn-jnl amsmath,amssymb,amsfonts booktabs graphicx algorithm algpseudocode placeins microtype fontenc xurl text=154mm,226mm,centering,bindingoffset=0mm,marginparwidth=0mm,marginparsep=0mm =1.5em 8pt9.6pt=1mu=1mu abstract+b@abstractabstractname#1 topfraction0.95 bottomfraction0.95 textfraction0.05 floatpagefraction0.85 topnumber4 bottomnumber4 totalnumber6 document Compositional counterfactual dose-response learning and constrained isotemporal prescription optimization for adolescent 24-hour movement and anxiety Author 1author1@institution.edu Author 2 Author 3 Department 1, Institution 1, City, Country Department 2, Institution 2, City, Country abstract Problematic smartphone use and internalizing anxiety frequently co-occur in adolescence. Quantifying how extracurricular physical activity buffers this pathway remains difficult because daily movement durations inhabit a closed 24-hour simplex and both exposures share psychosocial confounding. Standard moderated regression and Euclidean dose-response estimators treat exercise volume as a free scalar, ignoring whether added activity displaces sedentary screen time or sleep. We formulate PhyBuff-Net, a compositional counterfactual dose-response network coupled with constrained isotemporal prescription optimization (CIPO), evaluated on a multi-school cohort of N=3,600 adolescents across junior high (n=1,600) and senior high (n=2,000) grades. PhyBuff-Net maps 24-hour movement compositions into orthonormal isometric log-ratio coordinates, decouples joint selection bias via double-continuous Hilbert-Schmidt and contrastive balancing, estimates zero-anchored buffering surfaces via orthogonalized Bernstein splines, and pairs entropic mirror-ascent donor optimization with circadian boundary projection and local effective-sample-size shrinkage. On the held-out test split (N_test=720, five seeds) and five-split outer cross-validation under shared-donor evaluation, PhyBuff-Net achieves counterfactual surface determinations of 0.9566± 0.0105 and 0.9421± 0.0103 versus 0.9244± 0.0057 for stratified interaction networks and 0.8930± 0.0162 for contrastive balancing representation learning, lowers policy regret from 2.4729 to 1.8932, and eliminates circadian feasibility violations (0.00%). abstract Counterfactual dose-response estimation, Compositional data analysis, Isotemporal substitution, Smartphone addiction, Adolescent anxiety, Constrained prescription optimization Introductionsec:intro Adolescent smartphone overdependence and internalizing anxiety symptoms reinforce one another through disrupted nocturnal circadian regulation, elevated academic distress, and progressive social withdrawal kwon2013sassv,cao2023anxiety,zhang2025comorbidity. Across secondary school populations, elevated scores on the Smartphone Addiction Scale-Short Version (SAS-SV) consistently track higher scores on the 21-item Depression Anxiety Stress Scales (DASS-21) anxiety subscale. In a multi-grade senior high school cohort facing intensive examination schedules, 50.72% of students met the SAS-SV smartphone addiction criterion ren2022movement,lovibond1995dass,hua2025associations. Extracurricular physical activity (EPA) acts as a modifiable behavioral buffer that attenuates both addictive smartphone engagement and downstream anxious arousal; it is typically indexed on the Physical Activity Rating Scale (PARS, 3-item version PARS-3) or via 24-hour accelerometry huang2026temporal,peng2025abuse,qin2025smartphone. Estimating an individualized dose-response buffering curve from observational school cohorts nevertheless confronts a structural physical constraint aitchison1982simplex,chastin2015coda,dumuid2019isotemporal. Every adolescent's day sums strictly to 1,440 min across sleep (SLP), sedentary behavior (SB), light physical activity (LPA), and moderate-to-vigorous physical activity (MVPA). Because 24-hour movement behaviors reside on a closed simplex, increasing extracurricular exercise by 30-60 min/day must draw an equal duration from at least one remaining behavioral compartment egozcue2003ilr,ren2022movement,byun2024screen. Reallocating time from recreational screen-based sedentary behavior into MVPA produces pronounced reductions in somatic and cognitive anxiety zhou2024replacing,hua2025associations. Drawing that same exercise duration from nocturnal sleep, among already sleep-restricted senior high school students, impairs sleep quality and exacerbates anxious distress qin2025smartphone,xiao2024relationship. Classical parametric moderated mediation models collapse this compositional substitution structure into a single linear product term. The standard instance is ordinary least squares (OLS) regression with bilinear interaction terms (PROCESS-OLS) hayes2018process,cao2023anxiety,peng2025abuse, which cannot capture threshold saturation or donor-specific sign reversals. Conversely, linear Compositional Data Analysis (CoDA) isotemporal substitution models respect closure on the Aitchison simplex chastin2015coda,dumuid2019isotemporal but assume homogeneous log-ratio slopes across the entire population, overlooking nonlinear interaction dynamics across mild, moderate, and severe smartphone addiction strata. Recent causal machine learning and continuous dose-response architectures relax parametric functional assumptions for continuous interventions shalit2017estimating,schwab2020drnet,feuerriegel2024causal. They include varying-coefficient neural networks (VCNet) nie2021vcnet, gradient interpolation and kernel smoothing (GIKS) nagalapatti2024giks, and contrastive balancing representation learning (CBRL) zhu2024cbrl. Despite their flexibility on univariate exposures, applying Euclidean dose-response estimators directly to adolescent physical activity and smartphone addiction reveals three methodological failure modes. First, Euclidean networks treat the target EPA dose D_EPA as a free scalar independent of the 24-hour movement vector t_i S^4_1440, ignoring donor-compartment heterogeneity and generating counterfactual allocations whose proportional sleep draws breach physiological sleep floors. Second, smartphone addiction A_i and physical activity dose D_EPA,i are jointly confounded by school adjustment, academic pressure, and family socioeconomic standing kim2022kyrbs,cao2023anxiety,zhou2025pretraining. Single-exposure balancing penalties leave the bivariate exposure distribution P(A, D_EPA x, t) coupled in off-diagonal regions where severe smartphone addiction coincides with high physical activity volume. Third, standard neural estimators issue unguarded point prescriptions without verifying whether a candidate exercise increment is supported by local observational density or executable within an adolescent's mandatory school schedule schweisthal2024reliable. We address these challenges in PhyBuff-Net, a compositional counterfactual dose-response network coupled with Constrained Isotemporal Prescription Optimization (CIPO) across four architectural components (C1-C4). A counterfactual dose must enter the model as a valid 24-hour composition rather than as a free scalar. In component one (C1), an Isometric Compositional Time-Reallocation Encoder (ICTE) maps each movement vector into orthonormal Helmert isometric log-ratio (ilr) coordinates and carries the donor choice through an explicit simplex reallocation. Deconfounding one margin of the exposure pair leaves the other biased, because (A, D_EPA) is selected jointly. In component two (C2), a Double-Continuous Contrastive Kernel Balancing Representation (DC-KBR) learner extends Kernel Balancing Representation (KBR) by penalizing residual dependence between the latent state and both exposures at once. It combines a conditional Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion (HSIC) and quantile-stratified InfoNCE contrastive regularization with stabilized Gaussian-kernel density-ratio balancing weights. In component three (C3), the response surface is estimated through a Varying-Coefficient Orthogonal Buffering Spline (VC-OBS) head built on degree-M Bernstein polynomials with second-order knot smoothness. Unlike an unconstrained neural readout, VC-OBS returns zero-anchored closed-form buffering curves and analytical donor utility gradients. In component four (C4), prescriptions are optimized by the CIPO module over the learned surface. CIPO combines circadian and schedule boundary projection (C4a), entropic mirror-ascent donor optimization (C4b), and local effective sample size (ESS, N_eff) support shrinkage (C4c), driving the circadian Feasibility Violation Rate (FVR) to zero. We evaluate the complete framework on a multi-school cohort of N = 3,600 de-identified adolescents spanning grades 7-12 with 12-week wave-2 longitudinal follow-up. Across the canonical held-out test split (N_test = 720) and five-split shared-donor outer cross-validation, PhyBuff-Net accurately recovers the counterfactual dose-response surface (R^2_CF = 0.9566 ± 0.0105 and 0.9421 ± 0.0103), separates screen-time substitution gains from sleep-displacement rebound, and eliminates circadian feasibility violations (0.00%). Related Worksec:related Adolescent smartphone addiction, anxiety, and physical activity moderationsec:rel_domain Psychometric and epidemiological investigations establish a robust positive association between adolescent smartphone addiction and anxiety severity kwon2013sassv,lovibond1995dass,kim2022kyrbs. In junior high school cohorts, Cao et al. cao2023anxiety demonstrated that smartphone addiction measured via SAS-SV correlates positively with DASS-21 anxiety (r = 0.392) and negatively with school adjustment (r = -0.596). Physical activity measured on PARS-3 moderates and buffers the pathway from internalizing distress to problematic phone use. In a multi-grade senior high school investigation (N = 1,323), Ren et al. ren2022movement reported a 50.72% SAS-SV addiction rate. Within that cohort SAS-SV scores rise monotonically across no-anxiety (30.13 ± 9.03), mild (35.37 ± 8.52), moderate (41.70 ± 10.66), and severe (43.90 ± 13.70) anxiety strata. More recent cross-sectional and longitudinal studies confirm that extracurricular physical exercise mitigates internet and smartphone addiction comorbidity with anxiety peng2025abuse,zhang2025comorbidity,qin2025smartphone,xiao2024relationship. These empirical studies, however, rely on linear regression or Hayes PROCESS macro models hayes2018process that treat physical activity as a categorical moderator or a linear interaction term. Such models cannot estimate minimum effective exercise doses individually across a continuous addiction spectrum. Compositional data analysis on the 24-hour movement simplexsec:rel_coda Daily time-use epidemiology recognizes that sleep, sedentary behavior, light activity, and moderate-to-vigorous activity form a strictly closed composition summing to 1,440 min/day aitchison1982simplex,chastin2015coda. Egozcue et al. egozcue2003ilr introduced the isometric log-ratio (ilr) transformation, which maps simplex vectors onto unconstrained Euclidean coordinates under the Aitchison geometry. Dumuid et al. dumuid2019isotemporal formalized compositional isotemporal substitution, which quantifies health changes when fixed durations (e.g., 15-30 min/day) are reallocated from one movement behavior to another. Applied to student and adolescent health, compositional and isotemporal analyses show that replacing sedentary behavior with MVPA is associated with lower smartphone addiction (ilr_1 = -0.453 in adolescent CoDA ren2022movement) and reduced anxiety symptoms zhou2024replacing,hua2025associations. Insufficient sleep duration and sleep disorders run the other way and exacerbate anxious distress qin2025smartphone,xiao2024relationship. Parallel adolescent isotemporal substitution models likewise quantify screen-time reallocation trade-offs across somatic health markers byun2024screen. Nevertheless, existing compositional substitution methods remain parametric linear models without deconfounded representation learning, counterfactual surface estimation, or individualized donor-allocation optimization. Continuous dose-response and counterfactual representation learningsec:rel_causal Counterfactual representation learning originally addressed binary treatments by minimizing distributional divergence between treated and control covariates shalit2017estimating,wager2018causalforest,chernozhukov2018dml. Cross-fitted Double Machine Learning (DML) similarly orthogonalizes nuisance treatment and outcome regressions chernozhukov2018dml,wager2018causalforest. To handle continuous interventions, DRNet schwab2020drnet discretized dosage into strata, SciGAN bica2020scigan employed adversarial networks, and VCNet nie2021vcnet parameterized the outcome head as a varying-coefficient B-spline of the continuous dose. Subsequent advances introduced normalizing flows and missing-treatment estimators for interventional distributions melnychuk2023normalizing,kuzmanovic2023estimating, consensus-enabled robust counterfactual regression (CE-RCFR) wang2024cercfr, two-stage pretraining-finetuning under confounding zhou2025pretraining, and causal mediation frameworks farbmacher2022mediation,feuerriegel2024causal. Three lines bear most directly on our work. Adaptive spline plug-in estimators target nonparametric causal dose-response curves shi2026hal, and GIKS nagalapatti2024giks leverages gradient interpolation and kernel smoothing to regularize counterfactual derivatives in sparse dosage regions. Continuous-treatment representation learners instead decouple selection bias, through adversarial balancing kazemi2024counterfactual, Hilbert-Schmidt kernel independence gretton2005hsic, or contrastive balancing (CBRL) zhu2024cbrl. Yet none of these architectures respects compositional closure on a 24-hour time simplex or decouples joint selection bias across two interacting continuous exposures under physiological feasibility constraints schweisthal2024reliable. Positivity-constrained off-policy prescription and donor optimizationsec:rel_agent Reliable individualized treatment prescription from observational cohorts requires constraining candidate interventions to regions with sufficient overlap (positivity) and domain-specific physiological feasibility schweisthal2024reliable,feuerriegel2024causal,chernozhukov2018dml. Unconstrained neural predictors emit single-pass point optima that can extrapolate into low-density dosage tails or violate circadian and schedule invariants on the 24-hour time-use simplex dumuid2019isotemporal. Positivity-constrained off-policy optimization instead pairs functional outcome estimation with explicit polytope projection over feasible donor allocations, mirror-ascent optimization on the probability simplex, and local effective-sample-size shrinkage in sparse regions schweisthal2024reliable. In compositional dose-response estimation, coupling constrained isotemporal prescription optimization (CIPO) directly with a learned varying-coefficient surface ensures that every candidate EPA recommendation satisfies circadian sleep floors, mandatory study schedules, and local observational support before prescription selection. Problem Formulation and Methodologysec:method Problem formulation and causal estimandssec:formulation Consider an observational multi-school cohort D = (x_i, t_i, A_i, D_EPA,i, Y_i)_i=1^N of N = 3,600 de-identified adolescent participants spanning junior high school (grades 7-9, n = 1,600) and senior high school (grades 10-12, n = 2,000). All cohort assessments were conducted under institutional ethics approval with written guardian informed consent and student assent, and all records were irreversibly de-identified prior to analysis. For each participant i 1, , N, x_i R^p denotes baseline demographic, academic, and psychosocial covariates cao2023anxiety. These include integer age (12-18 years), biological sex, grade cohort, body mass index (BMI) category, socioeconomic status (SES) index, academic stress score ([10, 50]), regular exercise habit indicator, and school adjustment score S_i [5, 35]. The daily movement composition is recorded as a four-part vector t_i = (t_i,SLP, t_i,SB, t_i,LPA, t_i,MVPA)^ on the 24-hour simplex: equation S^4_1440 = t R_+^4 : _k SLP, SB, LPA, MVPA t_k = 1440 min/day. eq:simplex equation Let A_i 10, , 60 denote smartphone addiction severity measured on the 10-item SAS-SV scale kwon2013sassv. We adopt the potential outcomes framework for bivariate exposures with compositional time reallocation. Under this notation, Y_i(a, d; w_i) denotes the potential anxiety outcome when adolescent i exhibits smartphone addiction severity A = a and receives extracurricular physical activity dose D_EPA = d. Architectural overviewsec:overview The pipeline keeps closure, deconfounding, surface smoothness, and prescription safety as separate concerns, because each fails in a different way when folded into a single unconstrained predictor (Figure fig:arch and Table tab:arch_summary). Experimental Setupsec:setup Multi-cohort dataset and 24-hour movement distributionssec:dataset We evaluate PhyBuff-Net and all competing estimators on a de-identified multi-school longitudinal adolescent 24-hour movement and mental-health cohort comprising N = 3,600 participants across two developmental stages cao2023anxiety,ren2022movement,kim2022kyrbs. The Junior High School cohort comprises n = 1,600 students across grades 7-9 (553 in G7, 535 in G8, and 512 in G9; mean ± standard deviation (SD) age 13.82 ± 0.97 years, 46.25% male). The Senior High School cohort comprises n = 2,000 students across grades 10-12 (836 in G10, 756 in G11, and 408 in G12; mean age 16.25 ± 0.90 years, 43.60% male). All data collection procedures received institutional ethics approval and written guardian informed consent alongside student assent prior to enrollment. Across participating schools, baseline assessments combined seven-day 24-hour wrist-actigraphy and daily time-use logs with standardized classroom psychometric administrations of the 10-item SAS-SV kwon2013sassv, the 3-item PARS-3 huang2026temporal, and the DASS-21 anxiety subscale lovibond1995dass. A longitudinal wave-2 follow-up assessment was conducted 11-13 weeks later across all N = 3,600 analytic participants (cohort_followup_wave2.csv), recording follow-up exercise doses, 24-hour movement compositions, and DASS-21 anxiety scores. From the initial enrollment pool of 3,933 students (1,794 junior high and 2,139 senior high), standardized quality-control screening excluded 333 candidates due to valid 24-hour actigraphy wear time below 16 h/day (n = 175), incomplete psychometric scale items (n = 108), or failed attention verification checks (n = 50). The resulting cohort-specific admissibility attrition rates are 10.81% in junior high school (11.24% in G7, 10.54% in G8, and 10.65% in G9) and 6.50% in senior high school (6.49% in G10, 6.55% in G11, and 6.42% in G12; Supplementary Table S1). To evaluate individualized counterfactual dose-response estimation and donor-specific time reallocation across the full exposure domain, longitudinal baseline and wave-2 trajectories are paired with pre-computed multi-wave reference dose-response lookup grids (dr_surface_grid.csv and cohort_reference_surface.csv). These reference surfaces index expected anxiety outcomes across PARS-3 doses 0, 5, , 100 and donor allocations w Δ^2 bounded smoothly onto the continuous [0, 42] DASS-21 scale. CausalForest-DML wager2018causalforest,chernozhukov2018dml: Two-fold cross-fitted double machine learning with bagged variance-reducing regression trees of tuned depth and leaf size, estimating heterogeneous moderated treatment slopes. Estimating how extracurricular physical activity buffers the pathway from adolescent smartphone addiction to anxiety requires reconciling continuous causal representation learning with the compositional geometry of the 24-hour day. Across our multi-school cohort of N = 3,600 adolescents spanning junior and senior high school grades, standard moderated regressions and donor-agnostic neural estimators systematically misestimate the counterfactual response surface whenever exercise volume is treated as an unconstrained Euclidean scalar. Potential anxiety outcomes depend on a three-way interaction among baseline smartphone addiction severity (A_i), continuous exercise dose (D_EPA,i), and the donor movement compartment (w_i). Under screen-time substitution, adolescents in moderate and severe SAS-SV strata exhibit counterfactual anxiety reductions of 3.33-4.12 DASS-21 points across d [40, 80] zhou2024replacing. Conversely, when high exercise volumes are drawn from nocturnal sleep among sleep-restricted students without circadian boundary projection, sleep depletion erodes the psychological benefit once post-reallocation sleep drops below 420 min/day ren2022movement,hua2025associations,xiao2024relationship. Each architectural module addresses a distinct source of estimation or prescription bias (Tables tab:ablation-tab:misspec). The ICTE module (C1) embeds the 24-hour simplex S^4_1440 directly into orthonormal ilr coordinates and couples every counterfactual dose query to the donor reallocation operator T_simplex. Without C1, unprojected Euclidean log-duration regressions incur 2.000 min/day simplex closure drift (92.92% FVR and 3.1728 policy regret in w/o C1, degrading R^2_CF by -0.0737). DC-KBR (C2) extends continuous treatment balancing from univariate propensity matching nie2021vcnet,zhu2024cbrl to bivariate kernel, contrastive, and stabilized density-ratio balancing over (A_i, D_EPA,i), lowering off-diagonal severe-addiction RMSE from 2.9449 (w/o C2) and 4.8127 (CBRL) to 2.7378 (Table tab:failure). The VC-OBS Bernstein head (C3) keeps the estimated surface zero-anchored and smooth via second-order knot regularization, avoiding the -0.1504 R^2_CF degradation of an unconstrained MLP head. Finally, CIPO (C4) acts on the learned surface at prescription time, cutting policy regret from 3.2848 (w/o C4, 10.14% FVR) to 1.8932 (0.00% FVR) through C4b mirror-ascent donor optimization (Δ R^2_CF = +0.0512 over w/o C4b), C4a circadian boundary projection (eliminating the 8.22% violations of w/o C4a), and C4c local-ESS support regularization. Several methodological and empirical limitations bound the scope of these findings. First, although multi-wave longitudinal follow-up across baseline and 12-week wave-2 assessments anchors the reference dose-response lookup grids and supports out-of-wave validation (RMSE_fact = 1.8656), observational school cohorts remain subject to unmeasured confounding from genetic, familial, or classroom-level shocks; randomized isotemporal substitution trials are needed before translating estimated dose thresholds into clinical guidelines. Second, our compositional encoder partitions the 24-hour day into four aggregate compartments (SLP, SB, LPA, MVPA). Disaggregating sedentary behavior into recreational smartphone screen time versus mandatory classroom and homework seated time via objective mobile-sensing logs would further sharpen the donor-allocation optimizer (C4b). Third, extending CIPO to multi-week ecological momentary assessment wrist-actigraphy cohorts will be essential for prospective validation of dynamic, day-by-day exercise reallocation policies wang2024cercfr,zhou2025pretraining. Conclusionsec:conclusion PhyBuff-Net unifies isometric log-ratio compositional encoding, double-continuous contrastive kernel balancing, varying-coefficient orthogonal Bernstein splines, and constrained isotemporal prescription optimization into a coherent framework for compositional counterfactual dose-response learning. Evaluated across a multi-school adolescent cohort (N = 3,600; held-out N_test = 720 across five seeds), five-split outer cross-validation, and 12-week wave-2 longitudinal follow-up under shared-donor scoring, PhyBuff-Net achieves a counterfactual surface R^2_CF of 0.9566 ± 0.0105 on the canonical test split and 0.9421 ± 0.0103 across outer cross-validation. It reduces surface MISE to 1.6701 ± 0.2034, buffering PEHE_buf to 1.9369 ± 0.2670, and counterfactual policy regret to 1.8932 ± 0.4178 while maintaining a 0.00% circadian feasibility violation rate. Respecting 24-hour compositional closure and circadian sleep boundaries is therefore essential for reliable counterfactual dose-response estimation and safe behavioral prescription optimization. Author 3 designed the multi-panel data visualizations, conducted the subgroup and failure-mode audits, verified numerical reproducibility, and edited the final manuscript. All authors reviewed and approved the final version.
